summary.text: Jeremy Shaffer is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 28 who has served since December 1, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Shaffer is an engineer and software company co-founder.

paragraphs.text: Jeremy Shaffer earned a B.S. in engineering from Tulane University in 1999, a master's degree and Ph.D. in electrical and computer engineering from Carnegie Mellon University in 2006, and an M.B.A. from the University of North Carolina.

His work experience includes co-founding a software company that provides inspection management services for bridges and roads and working as an executive at Bentley Systems, an infrastructure engineering software company.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Shaffer said he is a former township commissioner and board president, a member of the Northland Library Foundation and Northern Tier Library boards, and a youth sports coach.
In that survey he said he would be an advocate for fiscal responsibility and said Western Pennsylvania continues to lose population.
